1.sahih_international: By the night when it covers
1.yusuf_ali: By the Night as it conceals (the light);
1.shakir: I swear by the night when it draws a veil,
1.muhammad_sarwar: By the night when it covers the day,
1.mohsin_khan: By the night as it envelops;

2.sahih_international: And [by] the day when it appears
2.yusuf_ali: By the Day as it appears in glory;
2.shakir: And the day when it shines in brightness,
2.muhammad_sarwar: by the day when it appears radiant,
2.mohsin_khan: And by the day as it appears in brightness;

3.sahih_international: And [by] He who created the male and female,
3.pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female,
3.yusuf_ali: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-
3.shakir: And the creating of the male and the female,
3.muhammad_sarwar: and by that (Power) which created the male and female,
3.mohsin_khan: And by Him Who created male and female;
3.arberry: and That which created the male and the female,

4.pickthall: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).
4.yusuf_ali: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.
4.shakir: Your striving is most surely (directed to) various (ends).
4.mohsin_khan: Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse (different in aims and purposes);
4.arberry: surely your striving is to diverse ends.

5.sahih_international: As for he who gives and fears Allah
5.pickthall: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
5.yusuf_ali: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),
5.shakir: Then as for him who gives away and guards (against evil),
5.muhammad_sarwar: We shall facilitate the path to bliss
5.mohsin_khan: As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah and fears Him,
5.arberry: As for him who gives and is godfearing

6.yusuf_ali: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-
6.muhammad_sarwar: for those who spend for the cause of God,
6.arberry: and confirms the reward most fair,

7.sahih_international: We will ease him toward ease.
7.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
7.yusuf_ali: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.
7.shakir: We will facilitate for him the easy end.
7.muhammad_sarwar: observe piety, and believe in receiving rewards from God.
7.mohsin_khan: We will make smooth for him the path of ease (goodness).
7.arberry: We shall surely ease him to the Easing.

8.sahih_international: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
8.pickthall: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
8.yusuf_ali: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,
8.shakir: And as for him who is niggardly and considers himself free from need (of Allah),
8.muhammad_sarwar: But for those who are niggardly, horde their wealth,
8.mohsin_khan: But he who is greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient.
8.arberry: But as for him who is a miser, and self-sufficient,

9.yusuf_ali: And gives the lie to the best,-
9.muhammad_sarwar: and have no faith in receiving any reward (from God).
9.mohsin_khan: And gives the lie to Al-Husna (see Verse No: 6 footnote);
9.arberry: and cries lies to the reward most fair,

10.sahih_international: We will ease him toward difficulty.
10.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
10.yusuf_ali: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
10.shakir: We will facilitate for him the difficult end.
10.muhammad_sarwar: We shall facilitate the path to affliction
10.mohsin_khan: We will make smooth for him the path for evil;
10.arberry: We shall surely ease him to the Hardship;

11.sahih_international: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
11.pickthall: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
11.yusuf_ali: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).
11.shakir: And his wealth will not avail him when he perishes.
11.muhammad_sarwar: and their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they face destruction.
11.mohsin_khan: And what will his wealth benefit him when he goes down (in destruction).
11.arberry: his wealth shall not avail him when he perishes.

12.pickthall: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
12.yusuf_ali: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
12.shakir: Surely Ours is it to show the way,
12.muhammad_sarwar: Surely, in Our hands is guidance,
12.mohsin_khan: Truly! Ours it is (to give) guidance,
12.arberry: Surely upon Us rests the guidance,

13.sahih_international: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
13.pickthall: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
13.yusuf_ali: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.
13.shakir: And most surely Ours is the hereafter and the former.
13.muhammad_sarwar: and to Us belong the hereafter and the worldly life.
13.mohsin_khan: And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world).
13.arberry: and to Us belong the Last and the First.

14.sahih_international: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
14.pickthall: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
14.yusuf_ali: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;
14.shakir: Therefore I warn you of the fire that flames:
14.muhammad_sarwar: I have warned you about the fierce blazing fire
14.mohsin_khan: Therefore I have warned you of a Fire blazing fiercely (Hell);
14.arberry: Now I have warned you of a Fire that flames,

15.sahih_international: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
15.pickthall: Which only the most wretched must endure,
15.yusuf_ali: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
15.shakir: None shall enter it but the most unhappy,
15.muhammad_sarwar: in which no one will suffer forever
15.mohsin_khan: None shall enter it save the most wretched,
15.arberry: whereat none but the most wretched shall be roasted,

16.sahih_international: Who had denied and turned away.
16.pickthall: He who denieth and turneth away.
16.yusuf_ali: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.
16.shakir: Who gives the lie (to the truth) and turns (his) back.
16.muhammad_sarwar: except the wicked ones who have rejected the (Truth) and have turned away from it.
16.arberry: even he who cried lies, and turned away;

17.sahih_international: But the righteous one will avoid it -
17.pickthall: Far removed from it will be the righteous
17.yusuf_ali: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-
17.shakir: And away from it shall be kept the one who guards most (against evil),
17.muhammad_sarwar: The pious ones who spend for the cause of God
17.mohsin_khan: And Al-Muttaqun (the pious and righteous - see V. 2:2) will be far removed from it (Hell).
17.arberry: and from which the most godfearing shall be removed,

18.sahih_international: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
18.pickthall: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
18.yusuf_ali: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
18.shakir: Who gives away his wealth, purifying himself
18.muhammad_sarwar: and purify themselves will be safe from this fire.
18.mohsin_khan: He who spends his wealth for increase in self-purification,
18.arberry: even he who gives his wealth. to purify himself

19.sahih_international: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
19.pickthall: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
19.yusuf_ali: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
19.shakir: And no one has with him any boon for which he should be rewarded,
19.muhammad_sarwar: They do not expect any reward
19.mohsin_khan: And have in his mind no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
19.arberry: and confers no favour on any man for recompense,

20.sahih_international: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
20.pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
20.yusuf_ali: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
20.shakir: Except the seeking of the pleasure of his Lord, the Most High.
20.muhammad_sarwar: except the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High
20.mohsin_khan: Except only the desire to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High;
20.arberry: only seeking the Face of his Lord the Most High;

21.sahih_international: And he is going to be satisfied.
21.yusuf_ali: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
21.shakir: And he shall soon be well-pleased.
21.muhammad_sarwar: and the reward (of their Lord) will certainly make them happy.
21.mohsin_khan: He surely will be pleased (when he will enter Paradise).
21.arberry: and he shall surely be satisfied.
